p: scribe to bring the book of: Read Ezr 7:6.
that could hear with understanding: Who had age and discretion to understand.
midday: This declares the great zeal that the people had to hear the word of God.
above all the people: So that his voice might be heard the better.
wept: In considering their offences against the Law, therefore the Levites do not reprove them for mourning, but assure them of God's mercies if they are repentant.
prepared: That is, remember the poor.
joy of the LORD is your: Rejoice in the Lord, and he will give you strength.
roof of his house: For their houses were made with flat roofs, read De 22:8.
days of Jeshua the son of: Which was almost a thousand years.
